implementation.name: Game Gear (Analogue Pocket, spiritualized1997)
implementation.notes: Source availability (T5.4): closed -- the repository holds 1 file(s) and no HDL source at all; the core is published only as a built openFPGA package on the repository's GitHub Releases page. hdl_language_id and license_id are therefore omitted, and that absence is the releases-only signal (there is no open_source column in the delivered schema -- data-model.md §1.9). It is still recorded as a core: a closed core is still a core that exists for the hardware it covers. Machine mapping: hand-mapped, not setname-derived -- this core ships no MRA file. It reimplements the Sega Game Gear, giving machine_id gamegear, each checked against extract/machine.json. license_id omitted: with no published source there is no per-file grant to read; the repository carries no LICENSE file either. accuracy_id omitted: the repository makes no timing-fidelity claim this build could verify. openFPGA core identifier Spiritualized.GG; no core.json is committed to the repository (the manifest ships inside the release archive), so the identifier comes from the published core listing rather than from a file in the tree.
